concepts.gloss_en: The festival (regel/pilgrimage-festival) as the revelation of the Will

members.form: רגל ויום טוב שׁהוא התגלות הרצון

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same passage (lm2:4) with the same partner and both identify רגל (the festival) as the revelation of the Will. The only difference is the second form appends 'ויום טוב' (and Yom Tov), which is the same festival concept, not a distinct word or homograph. Same vocalization of רגל, same meaning — safe to keep grouped.
